question: Has Denova Oil been acquired by or merged with another company? Who owns Denova Oil now?
markdown:
Denova Oil (Denova Oil (Pty) Ltd), established in 2000 in the Limpopo Province of South Africa,
has not been acquired or merged
. It remains an independent brand owned and operated as part of a large, third-generation family-owned South African agro-processing organization.
Company Background & Ownership
Founders/Roots:
Founded by a network of local fruit and nut farming families in Limpopo, South Africa.
Current Structure:
Privately held as part of a legacy 3rd-generation agro-processing group that handles local farming, pressing, and export.
Core Products:
Specializes in unrefined, 100% pure and natural culinary oils such as avocado oil and macadamia nut oil.
